tools.name: get_tool_help
tools.description: Free blind-caller guidance for one tool visible on this MCP facade. Returns when to use it, what it refuses, a working example, effective access limits, important outputs, provenance fields, recommended next calls, and the shared natural-language-to-strict-JSON interaction contract. Use tools/list t

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Free discovery. Returns the list of live agent-ready data packs available on DaedalMap.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Free discovery. Returns detailed metadata, coverage, freshness, preferred canonical tool guidance, and first-query examples for one pack. Call this before querying a new pack so you can see time shape, coverage limits, and the paste-ready first query.

tools.name: search_disaster_links
tools.description: Free linked-disaster discovery helper. Searches published cross-disaster link families by event-type direction, optional via-event type, and optional year window. Use this when you want to discover whether a relationship family exists before you have an exact event id.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Generic structured query for direct source_id or pack_id access using the same contract as POST /api/v1/query/dataset. Free packs: currency, distributed_manufacturing, floods, nri, owid, un_sdg, un_wpp, volcanoes, world_bank_wdi. Paid packs: earthquakes, hurricanes, tornadoes, tsunamis, wildfires, w

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "query_dataset" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
